## About
Oasis Plant Shop is tucked into an old house on W Eighth St in the heart of Bishop Arts. There are a few rooms inside full of plants, plus an outdoor space and a back yard filled with more.
Along with plants for inside and out, you'll find home decor, outdoor patio decor and even cowboy pools. Kids can start at the play house in the front yard while you browse.
Neighbors rate us 4.6 on Google from 146 reviews, and we'd love for you to come see the place for yourself.

## Services
- Rooms full of plants: A few rooms inside full of plants, plus an outdoor space with more to choose from.
- Cowboy pools: Yes, we sell cowboy pools, and you can see one out in the back yard.
- Home and patio decor: Pieces for inside the house and for the patio. One reviewer went home with a Moroccan table runner alongside a prayer plant.

## FAQ
Q: Where are you?
A: 416 W Eighth St, Dallas, TX 75208, in the Bishop Arts District.

Q: Can you help me keep my new plant alive?
A: Ask us. One reviewer said the worker sent them home with plant care instructions.
